---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
keep_cats <- c(
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Household Activities",
  "Caring For & Helping Household (HH) Members",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
)

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100L) |>
  filter(hour >= 6L, hour <= 23L) |>
  left_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  filter(major_name %in% keep_cats) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(avg_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = fct_reorder(major_name, mean_minutes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_minutes, y = major_name, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "How Non-Employed Americans Spend Weekdays",
    subtitle = "Average daily minutes by sex and major activity category",
    x = "Average minutes per weekday",
    y = "Major activity category",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, American Time Use Survey (2003–2024). Weekday respondents not in the labor force."
  )
```

```{r}
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = avg_min, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22),
    labels = c("6 AM", "8 AM", "10 AM", "12 PM", "2 PM", "4 PM", "6 PM", "8 PM", "10 PM")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Weekday Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Average activity minutes by start hour and major category",
    x = "Activity start time",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Activity category",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, American Time Use Survey (2003–2024). Weekday respondents not in the labor force."
  )
```
